## Contribution rules for kubernetes-sigs/kueue

- Disclose AI assistance in the PR description. Example: "This PR was written in part with the assistance of generative AI" (https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md#L40)
- Do NOT add `Assisted-by`, `Co-developed-by` or similar AI commit trailers. (https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md#L42)
- Do NOT list an AI tool as co-author (no `Co-authored-by: <AI>` lines). (https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md#L42)
- A human must write replies to review comments; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/HEAD/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#L644)
- A human must write commit messages; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/HEAD/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#L638)
- The human contributor must have signed the CLA. (https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L15)
- Be able to explain every line of the change yourself. (https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/HEAD/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#L641)
- Keep PRs small and focused; split large AI-generated changes. (https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/HEAD/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#L638)
- Review and verify AI output yourself before asking for review. (https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/HEAD/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md#L640)
